headline: Suniel Shetty hails son-in-law KL Rahul after historic century
caption:
Suniel Shetty KL Rahul century New Zealand Test

Suniel Shetty ne damaad KL Rahul ke 136 runs par Instagram par pyaar bhara note likha.
Shetty ne likha: "Never defined by conditions or batting position. Always driven by a greater purpose...playing for TEAM INDIA."
Rahul New Zealand mein apne pehle Test innings mein sau banane wale teesre Indian bane.

headline: Ramayana box office collection day 16: Yash film beats KGF 2 to become his biggest blockbuster in India
caption:

16th din ki kamai Rs 16.30 crore net, worldwide gross Rs 1574.60 crore.
Ab ye India ki 4th highest-grossing film hai.
